data.content_ref: inline:The target's central claim—that coverage debt grows 'at least quadratically'—contradicts its own mechanism description. It states each new rival position requires O(k) criticism tasks where k = number of active schools. The problem context specifies 'frozen provider seats,' so k is effectively constant, making total criticism work O(n·k) = O(n), linear in the number of rivals. The quadratic prediction (option A in the simulation) requires 'unbounded per-position warrant requirements,' which directly contradicts the bounded O(k) mechanism the target itself describes. The target never explains how quadratic growth arises from its own stated mechanism, undermining its headline finding.
